requirementText: Workers must not be subjected to forced, bonded, indentured, involuntary prison labor, slavery or human trafficking. All employment must be voluntary.
Child labor is prohibited. Workers must be at least the age of 15 or the local minimum working age, whichever is higher.
Working hours must comply with local laws and not exceed 60 hours per week including overtime. Workers must receive at least one day off per seven-day period.

escalationConditions: Less than 1 day off per 7 days

requirementText: Wages paid must meet or exceed local legal minimum wage. Wage records must be accurate and maintained for all workers including temporary and contract workers.
Workers must not be subjected to harsh or inhumane treatment including any form of physical abuse, sexual harassment, verbal abuse, psychological coercion, or other forms of intimidation.

Employment decisions must be based on ability to perform job requirements, not personal characteristics. Workers must not be discriminated against based on race, color, age, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, ethnicity, religion, disability, union membership, political affiliation, marital status, or national origin.
Emergency procedures and response plans must be established, documented, and communicated to all workers. Emergency drills must be conducted at least quarterly.
All workers must receive comprehensive safety training upon hiring and refresher training at least annually. Job-specific safety training must be provided for high-risk roles.
Appropriate PPE must be provided at no cost to workers. PPE must be maintained and workers must be trained on proper use. Compliance must be monitored and enforced.
Safety Data Sheets must be current, accessible, and in local languages for all chemicals used. Expired SDS must be replaced within 30 days. Chemical storage must comply with applicable regulations.

All emergency exits must remain unobstructed at all times. Exit pathways must maintain a minimum clear width of 80cm. Emergency exit signage must be illuminated and visible. Exit doors must open freely and not require special tools or knowledge to operate.
First aid supplies must be readily available and accessible. At least one trained first aid responder must be present during all working shifts. Emergency contact information must be posted visibly.
All required environmental permits and registrations must be current and maintained. Operations must comply with permit conditions.

Hazardous waste must be identified, tracked, and disposed of through licensed contractors. Waste manifests must be maintained and complete. Waste must not be stored on-site beyond regulatory limits (typically 90 days).

Air emissions must comply with applicable regulations. Emission monitoring must be conducted per permit requirements. Workers must not be exposed to concentrations exceeding occupational exposure limits.
All business dealings must be free from corruption, bribery, extortion, or embezzlement. Gifts and entertainment must comply with anti-corruption policies and be documented.

Worker personal information must be collected, stored, and processed with appropriate security measures. Access must be limited to authorized personnel. Workers must provide informed consent for data collection.

escalationConditions: No access controls on personal data

requirementText: A documented management system must be established to ensure compliance with the Code of Conduct. Management must designate a representative responsible for implementation.
Workers must have access to confidential grievance mechanisms. Mechanisms must be accessible in languages spoken by the workforce. Complaints must be investigated and resolved in a timely manner.
Non-conformances must be identified, documented, and corrected within defined timelines. Corrective actions must address root causes. Previous audit findings must be tracked to closure.
